prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Brand: ScanHub, a developer web platform that brings together security scanning findings from multiple code analysis tools.
The user has rejected all previous designs and wants a completely new, original-feeling, contemporary minimalist identity. This is a new generation from scratch; do not use any images in the conversation as references.
Deliver ONE polished landscape brand concept board for ONE coherent logo direction. Flat vector-like artwork, optically balanced, exceptional professional identity-design quality, crisp silhouettes, pure white background, generous intentional whitespace. No paper texture, no perspective, no device or stationery mockup, no 3D, no gradients, no shadows, no stock-logo feel.
Layout: dominant logo symbol with wordmark across the upper-middle of the board; a modest lower proof row showing the SAME symbol alone in black, the SAME symbol reversed white on a small black field, and the SAME symbol in the existing ScanHub cobalt blue #3b6fd8. A discreet option letter near the top-left. Keep the concept much larger than labels. This is a presentation image, not a collage of different identities.
Wordmark exact text: "ScanHub", carefully kerned, easily legible, tailored to the mark. No slogans, explanatory copy, other company names, fake vector grids, or watermark.
Important avoid list: no literal S symbol, no SH monogram, no scan corner brackets, no rounded square split by a horizontal seam, no circle or orbit or radar, no diamonds, no shields/locks/checkmarks, no recycled three-bar S, no connected lowercase n-h ligature. Do not resemble any famous brand. Prioritize a fresh silhouette and compact favicon-friendly geometry with meaningful negative space.
Option letter: "B". Direction: "Datum". Create an architectural, precise glyph about finding the significant detail inside layers of code. One strong vertical datum and a surprising counterform or offset fold, using only two or three solid areas. Tall, compact, calm, stable; editorial modernism for a premium developer tool. Neither a document/file icon nor a letter monogram. Keep the empty space essential to recognition. Black primary, blue only in lower color proof. Pair with a bespoke slightly condensed wordmark, restrained and beautifully spaced.
implementation: Geometric vector mark, wordmark traced from the selected concept. Inline SVG has no font or image dependencies.
